Definition: an Edomite, or descendants from (or inhabitants of) Edom
BiblicalUsage: An Edomite is a descendant of Esau, and the most famous one in the Bible is Doeg, Saul's chief herdsman. Doeg saw David at Nob and told Saul, and then he killed the priests of the Lord with his own sword when no one else would.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Doeg shows how far a man will go when he serves a king instead of God, because he murdered priests to please Saul. Loyalty to the wrong master is still treachery, and God saw it.
